skad cig gcig gis bye brag phyed/ /skad cig gcig gis rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /zhes so/ / 'di gnyis ka'ang gzhi la thugs rje shar bas/ g.yos pa 'dra la/ yul phyir ma bzung skad cig la rang mal du grol bas gzhi thog nas sangs rgyas par don gcig go /de yang shes rab rang shar rang rig pas gzhi la sangs rgyas te/ kun gsal las/ de bzhin phyogs lhung med pa'i shes rab kyis/ / mgon po gzhi nas rdzogs sangs rgyas pa la/ /bag chags 'khrul pa'i dri ma ka nas dag /ces so/ /spy-ir bar do la sogs gar grol yang*/ gzhi thog tu grol ba yin mod kyi/ gzhi las sems can du 'khrul nas yang grol ba la ltos nas gzhi thog nas grol ba yin yang*/ gzhi thog nas grol ba ma yin pas/ kun tu bzang po'i grol tshul dang mi 'dra bar shes par bya'o/ /lugs gnyis gcig tu bsdu ba ni/ lhun grub kyi gzhi la/ stong pa dang gsal ba gnyis rang so dang rang gdangs su ye nas yod pa de/ thugs rje'i ngo bo stong pa chos skur rig /rang bzhin lhun grub longs skur rig /thugs rje'i rang ngo sprul skur rig nas/ rang gsal las ma g.yos bzhin du gzhi thog tu sangs rgyas pa yin no/ /de la kun tu bzang po ni rang mal las ma g.yos par ngo bo ka dag tu grol/ rang bzhin lhun grub tu grol/ thugs rje rang rig tu grol bas/ snang bcas snang med gnyis ka ldog pas phye ba las/ ngo bo rdzas gcig ste/ sku gsum rang mal du dus gcig la grol pa'i phyir ro/ /lugs gnyis po slob dpon snga ma dag so sor 'dod kyang*/ kho bo gcig tu 'dod de/ ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje gsum las/ ngo bo snang med stong pa nang dbyings su/ rang bzhin 'od gsal snang ba rtsal du shar ba de gnyis gzhi rang mal 'od rang gdangs su/ thugs rje'i rig tshul 'char gzhi 'khor 'das ma 'gags pas/ phyis la ltos nas skyon yon ltar snang yang rang dus gang du 'ang ma chad pa/ rang ngo shes pas yon tan du grol te/

gzhi snang ga pur ltar rkyen gyis tha dad ngo bo gang du 'ang ma chad rtogs pas sangs rgyas pas/ ngo bo rang bzhin gnyis rtogs bya/ thugs rje rtogs byed du shar te/ lhun grub rin po che 'bras bu rang sa zin pa ni/ kun gsal las/ rang rig gcig las med bzhin du/ /'khor 'das gnyis la tha dad snang*/ /ga pur sman dug dbyer med kyang*/ /sman dang dug tu snang ba bzhin/ /gnyis med gzhi snang chen po de/ /gnyis med ngang las ma g.yos kyang*/ /yon tan stobs kyis snang ba'o/ /du mar snang ba yod tan la/ /'khrul bar snang ba skyon ltar bshad/ / rtogs pas skyon nyid yon tan grol/ /zhes gsungs so/ /༈ spyi don gnyis pa ma rig pa sems can gyi 'khrul tshul la gnyis te/ bskal pa gsum gyi rim pa spyir bstan pa dang*/ /'khrul tshul dngos kyi rim pa bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni rig pa lhun grub kyi gzhi la gzhi snang rang chas su yod pa de/ thugs rje'i rtsal du yod pas rang g.yos te/ phyir snang gdangs su shar nas gzung bas 'khrul pa la bskal pa gsum rtsi ba ni/ gzhi snang dbyings las ma g.yos pa bskal pa dang po/ rang gdangs phyir gsal ba la 'khrul yang ma 'khrul yang*/ ma grol bar dar cig gnas pa bar gyi bskal pa de/ ma rig dngos su med la/ rang ngo ma shes pa'i cha mtshungs ldan tsam du yod pas myu gu'i gnas skabs te/ cha yi ma rig pa 'od lnga nang du 'gribs par phyogs kyang*/ sems can du ma 'khrul ma bskyed pas mi bskyod rdo rje rig par phye'o/ /gsal ba'i bdag nyid can zhes bya'o/ /de nas 'dzin pa skyes nas sems can du 'khrul dus/ bskal ba tha ma zhes bya'o/ /de thams cad kyi gnas skabs na gzhi rang ngo la sngar ma 'khrul/ da lta 'khrul pa med/ phyis 'khrul mi srid pa chos sku dri med zang thal du gnas pa/ nyi ma la mun pa snga phyi dus gsum du med pa lta bu'o/ /'on kyang rkyen nam/ rnam pa la 'khrul par snang ba sprin gyis bsgribs par snang ba'am/

man shel ras gang 'phrad du dar cig 'gyur 'gyur 'dra ba bzhin te/ bshad rgyud las/ rigs kyi bu legs par nyon cig /gzhi 'gyur ba med pa ye nas sangs rgyas pa'i bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'chang chen po yin pas/ sngar yang 'khrul ma myong*/ da ltar yang ma 'khrul la/ phyis kyang 'khrul mi srid do/ /dper na nyi ma'i snying po la mun pa'i gzhi med pa lta bu'am/ man shel rkyen gang 'phrad pa der snang yang dag pa'i stobs kyis snang mod kyi shel la ma gos pa bzhin no/ /zhes so/ /bskal pa gsum yang de nyid las/ rigs kyi bu de la mtshon pa'i tshig bstan pa/ dang po gzhi snang gong du gnas/ sangs rgyas 'og tu gnas/ de gnyis bar du rtsal sbyong ba/ bar gyi bskal par bshad pa yin/ / rang gi so la gnas pas na/ /mi bskyod pa zhes de la bya/ /de ma yin la de 'dzin gyis/ /'od lnga 'gribs shing rig pa stong*/ /mi bskyod rdo rje yin par bshad/ /grol ma nus pas phye ba yin/ /ngo bo gsal la ma 'gags kyang*/ / dngos su gsal ma nus pas na/ mi gsal gsal ba'i bdag nyid can/ / gzhi las 'phags kyang dngos

sangs rgyas sems can gang rung ma yin/ /bar du myu gu bzhin du gnas/ /myu gur byung zhes de la bya/ /de ni ngas bstan rgyud nang du/ / gang byung de ni shes par gyis/ /zhes pa dang*/ ngas bstan rgyud lung thams cad du/ bskal ba tha ma'i tshig brjod pa/ /tshogs brgyad bcas phyir sems can no/ /de yang 'gyur byed kyi dbugs yod pas rtog byed kyi sems yod par bshad do/ /zhes so/ /༈ gnyis pa 'khrul tshul dngos kyi rim pa bye brag tu bshad pa la lnga ste/ bshad rgyud las/ 'khrul lugs rgyas par ngas bshad kyi/ /'khrul pa'i gzhi dang rgyu dang dus/ /'khrul pa'i rkyen dang 'khrul ba dngos/ /zhes pas/ dang po 'khrul pa'i gzhi la gsum/ lhun grub kyi chos nyid rig pa/ 'od lnga rnams phyir gsal du yul dang*/ sems dang lus kyi 'khrul gzhir dang po dang*/ bar dang*/ tha ma gsum gyis bshad nas/ 'khrul gzhir phyogs tsam mthun pas 'thad pa yang*/ de nyid las/ dang po 'khrul ba'i gzhi bstan pa// de la yang ni rnam pa gsum/ /chos nyid yul gyi 'khrul gzhi dang*/ /rig pa sems kyi 'khrul gzhi dang*/ /'od lnga lus kyi 'khrul gzhir bstan/ /dang po chos nyid rigs pa stong*/ /bar du ye shes rnam par shar/ /tha mar 'dzin rtog bag chags brtas/ /de las sny-igs ma med bzhin snang*/ /de ni yul gyi 'khrul gzhir bstan/ /da ni sems kyi 'khrul gzhi bshad/ /dang po rig pa 'gags med 'gyus/ /bar du gdangs la 'dzin pa skyes/ /tha ma sems kyi rgyu phyungs bas/ /de las sems rtog du ma shar/ /sems kyi gzhi ru de bstan no/ /da ni lus kyi 'khrul gzhi bstan/ /dang po rig pa'i klong na snying po lnga gsal/ /bar du chos nyid klong na shar sku lnga po de / /tha ma de la bag chags pas//gzugs kyi phung po rdos bcas snang*/ /lus kyi 'khrul gzhi dpe bstan no/ /gzhi gsum 'thad pa ngas bshad kyis/ /kye kye gsang bdag nges par zung*/ / chos nyid yul gyi 'khrul gzhir 'thad/

/ci'i phyir rig med bems por snang*/ /rig pa sems kyi 'khrul gzhir 'thad/ /ci'i phyir rig tsam phyogs mthun phyir/ /'od lnga yul gyi 'khrul gzhir 'thad/ kha dog dbyibs su phyogs mthun phyir/ /zhes so/ /spyir gyi gzhi ni lhun grub yin la/ 'khrul gzhi ni de las bar gyi bskal par shar ba'i rig gdangs yin pas phyed pa gces so/ /༈ gnyis pa 'khrul rgyu ma rig pa las/ ngo bo zhes pa rmongs pa/ nges tshig mi shes pa/ dbye na rig pa'i cha la rang nyid ye shes su mi shes pa'i chos lhan cig skyes pa dang*/ rang las gzhan du 'dzin pa kun tu brtags pa'i ma rig pa gnyis so/ /dpe rgan mo long mas sa tshugs med par 'khyams pa lta bu'o/ /'khrul tshul ni/ thag pa sbrul 'dzin ltar rang ngo la med kyang snang ngo la shar ba la sogs pas bzung bas 'khrul lo/ /ming gi rnam grangs ma rig / gti mug /mi shes/ ma rtogs/ ma mthong*/ 'khrul pa/ phyin ci log ces pa ste/ kun gsal las/ 'khrul pa'i rgyu ni ma rig pa/ /lhan cig skyes dang kun tu brtags/ /ngo bo nges tshig dbye ba dang*/ /mthun dpe tshul dang brjod tshig bstan/ /rigs kyi bu ma rig pa'i ngo bo ni/ /gti mug dang*/ de ma yin pa la der 'dzin pa'o/ /nges tshig ni/ don la rmongs pa'i phyir ma rig pa'o/ /dbye na gnyis te/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ma rig pa dang*/ kun tu brtags pa'i ma rig pa'o/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i ma rig pa de gang las gang dang*/ gang lhan cig tu skyes na/ gang gis gang ma rig ce na/ rigs kyi bu gang las zhe na/ gzhi 'dzin pa'i rig pa las so/ /gang dang zhe na/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes dang ma rig pa gnyis so/ /gang zhe na/ bcos pas ma 'chos pa'i chos nyid klong du'o/ /gang gis gang ma rig ce na/ rang bzhin gyi 'od byad lta bus/ gzugs brnyan gyi 'od byad kyi rnam pa me long la snang ba lta bu de ma rig go / don des lhan cig skyes pa'i ma rig pa zhes bya'o/

/kun tu brtags pa ni yul la rtogs pa rags su skyes te/ skad cig ma snga phyi'i tshul lo/ /dpe ni rgan mo long ma dang 'dra'o/ /kye ma rigs kyi bu ma rig pa de yang*/ yang dag par yod pa ni ma yin te/ 'o na ji lta bur zhe na/ tho yor ram/ thag pa la sbrul dang*/ mi med yang rgyus med pa dang*/ sngar sun pa'i mi la dgrar snang ba'am/ rnam pa thag pa sbrul du snang ba lta bu'o/ /de ni yang dag par med bzhin du snang la/ snang bzhin du stong pa'o/ /rig kyi bu dpe de bzhin du/ ma rig pa dngos su med la nyams la yod pa'o/ /de cis byung zhe na/ lus kyi mtha' ma rdzogs pas/ shes rab kyi rtsal ma rdzogs/ mthong ba'i yul ye shes kyi gdangs 'od lnga la shes pa'i dran pa ma sad do/ /de sad ma g.yos pa'i ngang kun tu bzang po las/ de'i rang bzhin ye shes kyi 'byung ba yul la ma 'gags par snang ba la/ sngar mthong ma myong bas de la nga yis yid 'phrogs te/ rang snang chen po rtogs pa'i mtha' ma chod pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu ma rig pa'i gtan tshigs so/ /ma rig pa dang*/ gti mug dang*/ ma shes pa dang*/ ma rtog pa dang*/ don ma mthong ba dang*/ 'khrul pa dang*/ phyin ci log la sogs pa/ gar byung yang ma rig pa nyid du bshad do/ /zhes so/ /gsum pa 'khrul dus ni/ gzhi snang rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal las/ /rang gdangs gzugs brnyan gyi 'od shar dus/ 'dzin pa skyes nas 'khrul te/ de nyid las/ kye gsang ba'i bdag po/ 'khrul pa'i dus ni rang rig yul la shar te 'dzin pa skyes pa'i dus so/ /zhes so/ /༈ bzhi pa 'khrul pa'i rkyen la bzhi/ rgyu yi rkyen rig pa rang bzhin gyi 'od can/ bdag po'i rkyen gzugs brnyan gyi 'od rang las shar ba/ dmigs pa'i rkyen la yul du 'dzin pa'i rtog pa skyes pa/ de ma thag rkyen de gsum dus mtshungs pa ste/ rang bzhin gyi 'od gsal ma nus/ gzugs brnyan gyis 'od la bag chags pas 'khrul lo/ /༈ lnga pa 'khrul pa dngos ni/

sems can du smin nas snod bcud du smin pa ste/ gzugs brnyan gyi 'od lnga la bag chags pas snod kyi 'jig rten gling bzhi ri rab la sogs pa 'gro drug so so'i yul khams su snang ba dang*/ / 'od kyi thig le sgo nga lta bu la 'dzin pa skyes pas lus su 'khrul te/ 'od lnga'i thig le 'byung bzhi nam mkha' dang bcas pa las phung po lnga'i bag chags grub bo/ /'di la sgong skyes zer yang bya'i sgo nga ma yin la/ shed bu shed grogs zer yang*/ 'dzam gling du dang po byung ba'i lha gnyis la mi zer/ 'od kyi sgo nga la 'dzin pa skyes nas/ sems can pho mo shar ba'i ming ngo*/ /de yang rig pa'i ngang nas 'od dang thig le shar ba la bag chags pas yul dang lus su grub pa'o/ /de nas skye ba bzhi dang*/ 'gro ba drug la sogs pa tha dad 'khrul pa'i chos su snang ste/ kun gsal las/ de dus gzung 'dzin rnam rtog gis/ /rang bzhin 'od lnga gsal ma nus/ /gzugs brnyan lnga la bag chags pas/ / mtsho dar zho la spris chags ltar/ /gling bzhir ri rab gling phran rnams/ /de y-i bcud las srid pa'i sgo nga dang*/ /rtswi shing nags tshal sman dang me tog 'khrungs/ /rlan dang drod las skyes pa yin/ /zhes pa dang*/ nam mkha' stong la rlung 'gyu bzhin/ /yid kyi rlung chen kun tu 'gyu/ /spyan gyi sbyor bas srid pa'i sgo nga mthong*/ /thugs kyi sbyor bas sgo nga legs par mkhyen/ / zhal gyi sbyor bas de la chags sems skyes/ /rig pa yid dang bcas pa bzhugs/ /sems can pho mo gnyis su sma ི na/ /skye ba bzhi las sgong skyes yin/ /chen po lnga yi phung po brten/ /de la 'byung ba lnga rdzogs pas/ /phung po khams dang skye mched grub/ /shed bu shed la grogs su grags/ /de las mngal las skye ba byung*/ /mi mjed 'jig rten rim par chags/ /nyon mongs rags shing 'bras bu ngan/ /mtha' ma mnar med gnas la thug /ces so/ / de'ang rang bzhin gzugs brnyan gyi 'od shar dus/

sku lnga'i gdangs 'od kyi bum pa lnga las/ thig le snang ba la smin pa'i snang ba ste/ de la bag chags pas/ 'od lnga yul/ thig le lus kyi rten du 'khrul pa las/ nyams su len dus 'od dang thig le gong 'phel las/ 'od zhing khams su grol/ thig le skur smin nas/ lus rdos pa dngas sa rdo'i 'khrul pa dag ste/ mthar rang bzhin 'od kyi bum pa lnga/ nang gsal du grol ba'i gnad de/ des na 'od la bzung bas gzugs brnyan gyi 'od thig le dang bcas pa rang yal te/ de'i bag chags brtan pas snod bcud bde sdug tu snang ba 'di yin no/ /༈ spyi don gsum pa 'khrul dus dgongs pa'i gnas tshul bstan pa la lnga ste/ bskal pa tha ma'i chos sbyir bstan/ 'byung ba'i chos bye brag tu bshad/ sku dang ye shes kyi dgongs pa bstan/ sems dang ye shes kyi gnas tshul brjod/ nges don mthun pa'i rnam grangs dgod pa'o/ /dang po la bcu gsum ste/ phung po lnga/ dbang po lnga/ rten lnga/ shes pa lnga/ skyai mched bcu gnyis/ khams bco brgyad/ 'gro ba drug /skye ba bzhi/ lam lnga/ gnas drug /nyon mongs pa drug /rten 'brel bcu gnyis/ rnam par shes pa'i tshogs brgyad do/ /dang po ni gzugs/ tshor ba/ 'du shes/ 'du byed/ rnam par shes pa'i phung po lnga'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ mig /rna ba/ sna/ lce/ lus kyi dbang po lnga'o/ /gsum pa ni/ mig gi dbang rten zar ma'i me tog lta bu/ rna ba'i dbang rten gro ga gcus pa lta bu/ sna'i dbang rten zangs ma'i bu gu gshibs pa lta bu'o/ /lce'i dbang rten zla ba gam pa lta bu'o/ /lus kyi dbang rten reg na 'jam pa'i pags pa lta bu dang lnga ni yul lnga mthong ba'i rten/ dbang shes yul la shar ba'i sgo byed pas sgau lnga'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ gzugs 'dzin pa mig gi rnam shes/ sgra 'dzin pa rna ba'i rnam shes/ dri 'dzin pa sna'i rnam shes/ ro 'dzin pa lce'i rnam shes/ reg bya 'dzin pa lus kyi rnam shes dang lnga'o/ /yul gyi rnam par shes pas rnam shes te/

de dang 'dra ba skyes pa'i shes pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /skye mched bcu gnyis ni/ gzugs/ sgra/ dri/ ro/ reg /chos/ mig /rna ba/ sna/ lce/ lus/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i skye mched de/ yul drug gi rnam par shes pa la/ shes pa drug 'char zhing mched pa dang*/ snga ma las phyi ma skye zhing*/ mched pas skye mched do/ khams bco brgyad ni/ yul drug /dbang po drug /dbang shes drug spel ba ste/ mig dang*/ gzugs dang*/ mig gi rnam par shes pa dang*/ lce'i yid kyi bar la sbyor ro/ /mang zhing rgya che bas khams zhes bya'o/ /'gro ba drug ni/ dmyal ba/ yi dwags/ dud 'gro/ mi/ lha min/ lha'i 'gro ba'o/ /mi rtag cing gcig nas gcig tu 'pho zhing 'gro ba'i sems can yin pas 'gro ba zhes brjod do/ /skye ba bzhi ni/ sgong skyes/ mngal skyes/ drod gsher skyes/ rdzus skyes so/ /shes pa'i rten lus kyi snang ba tsam skye ba snang ba'i phyir ro/ / lam lnga ni/ dmyal ba gdung ba'i lam/ yi dwags 'gog pa'i lam/ byol song mun pa'i lam/ mi 'dam pa'i lam/ lha yengs pa'i lam mo/ /rang sa dpe da lta dang phyis kyi bde sdug tu bgrod cing phyin par byed pas lam/ rigs mi 'dra ba lnga yod pas na lam lnga'o/ /lha min ni 'dod lhar bsdus pa'o/ /gzhung kha cig las stod rigs lha/ smad rigs dud 'gror yang bshad do/ /gnas drug ni/ dmyal ba bzod ldan gyi gnas/ yi dwags yid ldan gyi gnas/ byol song snyogs ldan gyi gnas/ mi 'dod ldan gyi gnas/ lha min rtsod ldan gyi gnas/ lha dga' ldan gyi gnas so/ /sa der brten pas na gnas zhes bya'o/ /nyon mongs pa drug ni/ 'dod chags/ zhe sdang*/ gti mug /nga rgyal/ phrag dog/ khong khro/ /sdug bsngal la sbyor bar byed pa tha ma'i sems su byed pas na nyon mongs pa zhes bya'o/ /rten 'brel bcu gnyis ni/ ma rig pa/ 'du byed/ rnam par shes pa/ ming dang gzugs/ skye mched drug / reg pa/ tshor ba/

sred pa/ len pa/ srid pa/ skye ba/ rga shi'o/ /gcig la gcig brten rgyu rkyen 'brel chags su 'byung bas/ 'khor ba lugs 'jug tu byed pa'i phyir de skad ces bya'o/ /rnam shes tshogs brgyad ni/ kun gzhi'i rnam shes/ yid shes/ nyon yid/ sgo lnga'i rnam shes dang brgyad do/ /gzhan yul gyi rnam par shes pa sems yin pas rnam shes zhes btags so/ /brgyad ni/ nang tshan mi 'dra ba'i bye brag ga ོ /sems byung lnga bcu rtsa gcig ni/ sems kyi kun 'gror ldan pa de'i khongs su bsdus te/ mdor na khams gsum snod bcud du snang ba 'khrul pa'i chos thams cad bskal pa tha mar brjod do/ / kun gsal las/ kyai rdo rje 'dzin pa nyon cig /ngas bstan rgyud lung thams cad du/ bskal pa tha ma'i tshig brjod pa/ tshogs brgyad bcas phyir sems can no/ /de yang 'gyu byed kyi dbugs yod pas rtog byed kyi sems yod par mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (12)snyan brgyud kyi rgyab chos chen mo zab don gnad kyi me long*/ -PAGE 84-PAGE 85--PAGE 82-
